_note: Chapter 27 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: The hotel can accommodate up to three hundred guests.
ex.cn: 这家酒店最多可以容纳三百位客人。
ex.note: accommodate sb. 为某人提供住宿；be accommodated to 适应

ex.en: A young actor played the father in the film.
ex.cn: 一位年轻男演员在影片里饰演父亲。
ex.note: a film actor 电影演员

ex.en: Many teachers advocate smaller classes.
ex.cn: 许多教师主张小班教学。
ex.note: advocate doing 主张做某事；advocate a policy 提倡一项政策

ex.en: She is a strong advocate of low-cost science.
ex.cn: 她是低成本科学的坚定拥护者。
ex.note: an advocate of … …的提倡者/拥护者

ex.en: Stay alert for sudden changes in the weather.
ex.cn: 留意天气的突然变化。
ex.note: be alert to 对…保持警觉

ex.en: A fire alert was sent out at midnight.
ex.cn: 午夜时分发出了一条火警。
ex.note: raise an alert 发出警报；a false alert 误报

ex.en: The news alerted him to the danger.
ex.cn: 这个消息让他警觉起来。
ex.note: alert sb. to sth. 使某人对某事保持警觉

ex.en: The small room had ample space for a desk and two chairs.
ex.cn: 那间小屋有足够的空间放一张书桌和两把椅子。
ex.note: ample time/money/room 充足的时间/资金/空间

ex.en: Anyhow, the results were better than we had expected.
ex.cn: 不管怎样，结果比我们预想的要好。
ex.note: anyhow 常置于句首，表示转折或让步

ex.en: The journey takes approximately two hours.
ex.cn: 这段路程大约需要两小时。
ex.note: approximately = about，多用在数字、数量前

ex.en: He fell asleep over his notes and woke up at three.
ex.cn: 他伏在笔记上睡着了，醒来时已是三点。
ex.note: fall asleep 入睡；be fast asleep 熟睡

ex.en: She asked an attorney to review the contract.
ex.cn: 她请了一位律师审阅合同。
ex.note: 英式英语多说 solicitor

ex.en: She has a strong background in chemistry.
ex.cn: 她在化学方面有扎实的底子。
ex.note: background in … …方面的背景/经历

ex.en: He played baseball in high school and never missed a game.
ex.cn: 他在中学时打棒球，一场没落下。
ex.note: play baseball 打棒球

ex.en: They stopped at a small bar for a bottle of cold beer.
ex.cn: 他们在一家小酒吧停下来喝了一瓶冰啤酒。
ex.note: a bottle of beer 一瓶啤酒

ex.en: Hot beverages are served all day in the hotel lobby.
ex.cn: 酒店大堂全天供应热饮。
ex.note: beverage 多用于“食物与饮料”的正式场合

ex.en: There was blood on his knee after the fall.
ex.cn: 摔倒之后，他膝盖上有血。
ex.note: blood pressure 血压；blood type 血型

ex.en: He held up a bottle of milk to show the class.
ex.cn: 他举起一瓶牛奶给全班看。
ex.note: a bottle of … 一瓶…

ex.en: The report gives a broad picture of the situation.
ex.cn: 这份报告对整体局势勾勒出一个大致的面貌。
ex.note: a broad picture 全貌；in the broad sense 广义上

ex.en: They stopped to buy two bottles of a local drink.
ex.cn: 他们停下来买了两瓶本地的饮料。
ex.note: buy sth. for sb. 为某人买某物；buy time 争取时间

ex.en: She is quite capable of managing the project on her own.
ex.cn: 她完全有能力独自把这个项目管起来。
ex.note: be capable of doing 有能力做某事

ex.en: He ran back and managed to catch the ball.
ex.cn: 他往回跑，总算把球接住了。
ex.note: catch a train 赶上火车；catch someone's eye 引起某人注意

ex.en: The defending champion won the race by a few seconds.
ex.cn: 卫冕冠军以几秒之差赢得了比赛。
ex.note: champion of sth. 某项主张的拥护者

ex.en: The chief of the village welcomed the visitors.
ex.cn: 村长向客人们表示欢迎。
ex.note: chief of … …的负责人

ex.en: The chief engineer asked him three hard questions.
ex.cn: 那位总工程师问了他三个难题。
ex.note: chief reason 主要原因；chief concern 首要关注的事

ex.en: The audience clapped loudly when the band came on.
ex.cn: 乐队登台时，观众热烈鼓掌。
ex.note: clap one's hands 拍手；clap sb. on the back 拍某人后背

ex.en: He is clumsy with his hands and drops things often.
ex.cn: 他手上笨拙，东西常常掉。
ex.note: be clumsy at/in 在某方面笨拙；a clumsy mistake 笨手笨脚的错误

ex.en: She commands the respect of everyone in the room.
ex.cn: 她赢得满屋人的尊重。
ex.note: command sb. to do 命令某人做；command respect 赢得尊敬

ex.en: He gave the command, and the soldiers moved forward.
ex.cn: 他一声令下，士兵们向前推进。
ex.note: give a command 下命令；have command of 掌握

ex.en: The pattern is more complex than we first thought.
ex.cn: 这种图样比我们最初以为的更复杂。
ex.note: be complex for sb. 对某人来说太复杂

ex.en: The old factory complex will be turned into a park.
ex.cn: 那片老厂房将被改造成一座公园。
ex.note: a sports complex 运动中心；a complex about sth. 对某事的心理情结

ex.en: He registered for a graduate conference in March.
ex.cn: 他三月报名参加了一个研究生学术会议。
ex.note: attend a conference 参加会议；a conference on 关于…的研讨会

ex.en: The stream of data never stopped, a constant flow all winter.
ex.cn: 数据流从不停歇，整个冬天源源不断。
ex.note: a constant stream of 源源不断的；be constant to 对…始终如一

ex.en: The value of pi is a mathematical constant.
ex.cn: π 的值是一个数学常数。
ex.note: a mathematical constant 数学常数；a constant of 常量为

ex.en: The new office is convenient, only ten minutes from the station.
ex.cn: 新办公室很方便，离车站只有十分钟。
ex.note: be convenient for sb. 对某人来说方便；convenient for 对…方便

ex.en: She wore a soft cotton shirt to work in the garden.
ex.cn: 她穿着一件柔软的棉布衬衫在园子里干活。
ex.note: cotton shirt 棉衬衫；cotton wool 棉絮

ex.en: She is the most creative person in the whole studio.
ex.cn: 她是整个工作室里最有创造力的人。
ex.note: creative work 创意作品；creative thinking 创造性思维

ex.en: A few days of rest cured the problem completely.
ex.cn: 休息几天就把这毛病彻底治好了。
ex.note: cure sb. of sth. 治好某人的某病；cure a problem 解决一个问题

ex.en: There is no quick cure for loneliness.
ex.cn: 孤独没有速效药。
ex.note: a cure for … …的疗法/对策；be a cure for …

ex.en: All the readings were stored in a single database.
ex.cn: 所有读数都存进了同一个数据库。
ex.note: a database of … …的数据库；search a database 检索数据库

ex.en: There was a dramatic decrease in the fish catch last year.
ex.cn: 去年的渔获量大幅下降。
ex.note: a decrease in … …的减少；decrease by 减少了（数量）

ex.en: The department gave him a small laboratory by the harbour.
ex.cn: 系里在港口边给了他一间小实验室。
ex.note: the sales department 销售部；a department of 某系的

ex.en: He was determined to finish the thesis before the holiday.
ex.cn: 他下定决心要在假期前完成论文。
ex.note: determine to do 决心做某事；be determined to do 决心做某事

ex.en: The problem has a dimension that numbers alone cannot show.
ex.cn: 这个问题有一个单靠数字呈现不出来的维度。
ex.note: a new dimension 新层面；in another dimension 在另一个维度上

ex.en: He made a simple dish of rice and eggs.
ex.cn: 他做了一道简单的米饭炒蛋。
ex.note: a dish of 一道…；wash the dishes 洗碗

ex.en: Please sign this document and return it to the office.
ex.cn: 请在这份文件上签字，然后交回办公室。
ex.note: a travel document 旅行证件；official documents 官方文件

ex.en: He documented every reading in his notebook.
ex.cn: 他把每一次读数都记录在笔记本上。
ex.note: document sth. 记录某事；document the process 记录流程

ex.en: There was a dramatic fall in the number of fish.
ex.cn: 鱼的数量急剧下降。
ex.note: a dramatic change 剧烈的变化；dramatic increase 激增

ex.en: She experiments with natural dyes made from plants.
ex.cn: 她用植物做天然染料做实验。
ex.note: natural dye 天然染料

ex.en: They dyed the cloth with a red colour from beetroot.
ex.cn: 他们用甜菜根里的红色给布上色。
ex.note: dye sth. 给某物染色

ex.en: It was not a complete education, but it was a real one.
ex.cn: 这算不上一次完整的教育，却是一次真真实实的教育。
ex.note: receive an education 接受教育；a general education 通识教育

ex.en: If the job is not to your taste, try elsewhere.
ex.cn: 如果这份工作不合你的心意，就去别处找找。
ex.note: elsewhere 常与介词连用：go somewhere else / elsewhere

ex.en: The rules are useless unless someone enforces them.
ex.cn: 没有人来执行，这些规定就没用。
ex.note: enforce a rule 执行规定；enforce discipline 维持纪律

ex.en: The new sensor is equivalent to the old one in accuracy.
ex.cn: 新传感器的精度与旧的相当。
ex.note: be equivalent to 与…相等；an equivalent amount 等量

ex.en: There is no exact equivalent for this word in English.
ex.cn: 英语里没有与这个词完全对应的词。
ex.note: an equivalent for … …的对应物；the equivalent of … …的对等物

ex.en: The project evolved as more data came in.
ex.cn: 随着更多数据到来，项目逐步发展成形。
ex.note: evolve into 演变成；evolve from 由…演变而来

ex.en: I didn't expect to enjoy the afternoon, but I did.
ex.cn: 我本没指望这个下午会有多愉快，可我确实享受了。
ex.note: expect sb. to do 期望某人做；as expected 正如预期

ex.en: The university gave him a small facility near the harbour.
ex.cn: 学校在港口附近给了他一处小实验设施。
ex.note: research facilities 研究设施；with facility 轻松地

ex.en: The colours of the old costume fascinated him.
ex.cn: 那套旧戏服的色彩让他着了迷。
ex.note: be fascinated by 被…迷住；fascinating 有魅力的

ex.en: A female engineer asked him about his sensors.
ex.cn: 一位女工程师问起他的传感器。
ex.note: female and male 雌与雄

ex.en: Most of the students in the class were females.
ex.cn: 班上多数学生是女生。
ex.note: a female engineer 一位女工程师

ex.en: They built a small fire on the beach and sat until it died down.
ex.cn: 他们在沙滩上生起一小堆火，一直坐到火势渐弱。
ex.note: set fire to 放火；catch fire 起火

ex.en: The company fired three workers after the strike.
ex.cn: 罢工之后公司解雇了三名工人。
ex.note: fire sb. 解雇某人；fire an engine 发动引擎

ex.en: A hawk flew below them until it was a dot.
ex.cn: 一只鹰在他们身下飞，直到缩成一个小点。
ex.note: fly over 飞越；fly abroad 飞往国外

ex.en: A fly landed on his glass and would not move.
ex.cn: 一只苍蝇落在他杯子上，怎么也不走。
ex.note: a fly on the wall 眼中钉

ex.en: The interviewer was a former colleague of Professor Chen.
ex.cn: 那位面试官是陈教授的旧同事。
ex.note: former president 前总统；the former … the latter 前者…后者

ex.en: The story of the ghost frightened the younger students.
ex.cn: 那个鬼故事把低年级学生吓着了。
ex.note: frighten sb. to death 吓死某人；be frightened of 害怕

ex.en: They went to watch a baseball game on the north field.
ex.cn: 他们去北边的球场看了一场棒球赛。
ex.note: a football game 一场足球赛；a game of chess 一盘棋

ex.en: The old laboratory was said to have a ghost in it.
ex.cn: 据说那座老实验室里闹鬼。
ex.note: the ghost of … …的幽灵/残影

ex.en: The gossip in the office was that he had been promoted.
ex.cn: 办公室里流传的说法是他升职了。
ex.note: idle gossip 无聊的闲话；gossip about 关于…的流言

ex.en: Two old women gossiped about their neighbours all afternoon.
ex.cn: 两个老妇人整个下午都在议论邻居。
ex.note: gossip about sb. 说某人的闲话

ex.en: They grew tomatoes in a greenhouse on the roof.
ex.cn: 他们在屋顶的温室里种番茄。
ex.note: the greenhouse effect 温室效应

ex.en: She had a short haircut that made her look serious.
ex.cn: 她剪了短发，看起来多了几分认真。
ex.note: get/have a haircut 理发

ex.en: He had a good background, but he lacked confidence.
ex.cn: 他履历不错，缺的只是自信。
ex.note: have sth. done 让某人做某事；have a look 看一眼

ex.en: The evidence was solid, hence the cautious wording of the report.
ex.cn: 证据扎实，因此报告的措辞十分审慎。
ex.note: hence 多用于书面语，引出结果；henceforth 从今以后

ex.en: The defence was held two days before the holiday.
ex.cn: 答辩在假期前两天举行。
ex.note: on holiday 在度假；the summer holiday 暑假

ex.en: If you take the job, you should also think about the housework.
ex.cn: 如果你接下这份工作，也该想想家务活儿。
ex.note: do the housework 做家务

ex.en: His ignorance of the local rules cost him a fine.
ex.cn: 他对当地规矩的无知让他挨了一张罚单。
ex.note: ignorance of 对…的无知；ignorance is bliss 无知即幸福

ex.en: Her command of the practical side was impressive.
ex.cn: 她在实践方面的驾驭能力令人印象深刻。
ex.note: be impressive to sb. 给某人留下深刻印象

ex.en: From the readings we can infer what caused the change.
ex.cn: 从这些读数我们可以推断出变化的原因。
ex.note: infer sth. from sth. 从…推断出…；it can be inferred that 可以推断

ex.en: They installed twelve low-cost sensors along the coast.
ex.cn: 他们沿海岸安装了十二个低成本传感器。
ex.note: install software 安装软件；install sb. in a post 任命某人任职

ex.en: The data were easy to record but hard to interpret.
ex.cn: 这些数据容易记录，却难以解读。
ex.note: interpret for 为…做口译；interpret sth. as 把…理解为

ex.en: The work on the thesis began in January, when the lab windows were frosted over.
ex.cn: 论文的工作始于一月，那时实验室的窗玻璃上结着霜。
ex.note: in January 在一月；January to December 一月至十二月

ex.en: The evidence is strong enough to justify such a conclusion.
ex.cn: 证据足够有力，可以支撑这样的结论。
ex.note: justify doing 证明做某事是有道理的；justify oneself 为自己辩护

ex.en: He talked about the ladder a young engineer can climb.
ex.cn: 他谈到年轻工程师可以攀上的那条阶梯。
ex.note: a career ladder 职业阶梯；the ladder of success 成功之路

ex.en: The layout of the office was hard to read.
ex.cn: 这间办公室的布局让人看不分明。
ex.note: the layout of … …的布局；a room layout 房间布置

ex.en: He set himself one rule, lest ambition make him forget why he began.
ex.cn: 他为自己立下一条规矩，唯恐野心让他忘了当初为什么开始。
ex.note: lest 后接从句，lest he should lose his way 唯恐他迷路

ex.en: She listened carefully while he listed all the arguments.
ex.cn: 他一条条列举理由的时候，她听得很仔细。
ex.note: listen to 听；listen for 等候收听

ex.en: The team did not lose by much that afternoon.
ex.cn: 那天下午那支队伍输得不算多。
ex.note: lose one's way 迷路；lose one's life 丧生

ex.en: From the ridge they could see the mainland to the west.
ex.cn: 从山脊上他们能看见西边的大陆。
ex.note: the mainland 本土大陆；on the mainland 在大陆上

ex.en: He had to deal with a mass of small errors.
ex.cn: 他得应付一大堆细小的错误。
ex.note: a mass of 大量的；mass media 大众传媒

ex.en: Mass production has made the sensors cheap.
ex.cn: 大批量生产使传感器变得便宜。
ex.note: mass production 大规模生产；mass market 大众市场

ex.en: Soil and sand make a good medium for growing plants.
ex.cn: 土和砂是种植物的好基质。
ex.note: a medium for … …的媒介/手段；by medium of 通过

ex.en: She wanted a medium-sized pot for the young plants.
ex.cn: 她要给这些幼苗换一个中等大小的盆。
ex.note: medium size 中等尺寸；medium-sized 中号的

ex.en: They use milk on the plants to fight a kind of fungus.
ex.cn: 他们把牛奶浇在植物上，用来对付一种真菌。
ex.note: a glass of milk 一杯牛奶；milk powder 奶粉

ex.en: The lobby was modern, quiet and full of light.
ex.cn: 大堂很现代，很安静，光线充足。
ex.note: modern art 现代艺术；modern history 近代史

ex.en: In February they took a train west and climbed a mountain.
ex.cn: 二月里他们坐火车向西，去爬一座山。
ex.note: a mountain of work 海量的工作

ex.en: The prosperity of a nation depends on people willing to move.
ex.cn: 一个国家的繁荣，取决于那些愿意流动的人。
ex.note: a nation of 一个…的民族；the United Nations 联合国

ex.en: The sensors send their readings through a low-cost network.
ex.cn: 传感器通过一个低成本网络把读数发出去。
ex.note: a network of … …的网络；networking 人脉经营

ex.en: The company offered him a good salary in the north.
ex.cn: 那家公司给他开北方的一份高薪。
ex.note: in the north 在北方；north of 在…以北

ex.en: Her observations about the village changed his plan.
ex.cn: 她关于那个村子的观察改变了他的计划。
ex.note: make an observation 发表评论；an observation on/about 对…的观察

ex.en: He put the notes on the desk and sat down.
ex.cn: 他把笔记放在桌上，坐了下来。
ex.note: on the shelf 在架子上；depend on 取决于

ex.en: The meeting was still on when they arrived.
ex.cn: 他们到的时候会议还在进行。
ex.note: on and off 时断时续；the radio is on 收音机开着

ex.en: They use organic fertilizer and no chemical spray.
ex.cn: 他们用有机肥，不喷任何化学药剂。
ex.note: organic farming 有机农业；organic matter 有机物

ex.en: From the ridge they could overlook the whole coast.
ex.cn: 从山脊上他们可以俯瞰整片海岸。
ex.note: overlook a mistake 忽视错误；overlook the sea 俯瞰大海

ex.en: He wore a pair of old pants to work in the garden.
ex.cn: 他穿一条旧裤子在园子里干活。
ex.note: a pair of pants 一条裤子

ex.en: The path began behind the village and rose through pine trees.
ex.cn: 小路从村子背后开始，沿着松林往上爬。
ex.note: a path to … 通向…的道路；take a path 走一条小路

ex.en: He performed badly on the field, but he did not complain.
ex.cn: 他在场上表现得很差，却没有抱怨。
ex.note: perform a task 执行任务；perform well 表现良好

ex.en: He chose physics because he wanted to know how things work.
ex.cn: 他选物理，是因为想知道事物如何运转。
ex.note: study physics 学习物理；a physics teacher 物理老师

ex.en: From this platform you can see the whole harbour.
ex.cn: 从这个平台望出去，整个港口都在眼前。
ex.note: a railway platform 站台；a political platform 政治纲领

ex.en: A poll of the fishermen gave him a broad picture.
ex.cn: 对渔民做的一次调查让他看到了大致的图景。
ex.note: a public opinion poll 民意调查；a Gallup poll 盖洛普民意测验

ex.en: Half of the students were polled about their study habits.
ex.cn: 就学习习惯的问题对一半学生做了调查。
ex.note: poll sb. on sth. 就某事对某人进行调查

ex.en: He pushed a thin rod into each pot to hold up the plants.
ex.cn: 他往每只花盆里插一根细杆，把植株撑起来。
ex.note: a pot of soil 一盆土；a flower pot 花盆

ex.en: The old town was carefully preserved for future visitors.
ex.cn: 这座古镇被精心保存下来，留给后来的人。
ex.note: preserve sth. 保护某物；preserve peace 维持和平

ex.en: He learned to tell the difference between a problem and a fear.
ex.cn: 他学会了分清一个问题和一份恐惧。
ex.note: a problem with … …方面的问题；solve a problem 解决问题

ex.en: The prosperity of the whole region depends on the new railway.
ex.cn: 整个地区的繁荣都指望这条新铁路。
ex.note: economic prosperity 经济繁荣；bring prosperity 带来繁荣

ex.en: She took a tissue out of her purse and cleaned his knee.
ex.cn: 她从包里掏出一张纸巾，替他擦干净膝盖。
ex.note: a purse of money 一笔钱；empty one's purse 掏空钱包

ex.en: A rainbow stood in the air after the brief rain.
ex.cn: 那场急雨过后，天边挂起一道彩虹。
ex.note: a rainbow of colours 五彩缤纷

ex.en: He thought about the reason he had come to the city, and it seemed simple.
ex.cn: 他想起自己来这座城市的理由，那理由看上去简单得很。
ex.note: the reason for … …的原因；for no reason 毫无理由

ex.en: She reasoned carefully from the figures and reached a safer conclusion.
ex.cn: 她从数据出发仔细推理，得出了更稳妥的结论。
ex.note: reason about 对…进行推理；reason that … 论证…

ex.en: Put the milk back in the refrigerator before it spoils.
ex.cn: 把牛奶放回冰箱里，别让它变质。
ex.note: in the refrigerator 在冰箱里；a refrigerator for … 装…的冰箱

ex.en: He did not want to rely on a promise made in an interview.
ex.cn: 他不想依赖面试时说过的一句承诺。
ex.note: rely on/upon 依靠；rely on sb. to do 指望某人做

ex.en: The hotel had lost his reservation, so he had nowhere to stay.
ex.cn: 酒店把他的预订弄丢了，他连落脚的地方都没有。
ex.note: make a reservation 预订；have reservations about 对…持保留意见

ex.en: The company reversed its decision after a week.
ex.cn: 公司在一周后撤销了决定。
ex.note: reverse a decision 撤销决定；reverse into 倒车

ex.en: His answer was the reverse of what we expected.
ex.cn: 他的回答与我们预期的正好相反。
ex.note: the reverse of … …的相反；in reverse 反过来

ex.en: Write your name on the reverse side of the card.
ex.cn: 请在卡片背面写下你的名字。
ex.note: the reverse side 背面；in reverse order 顺序相反

ex.en: He pushed a thin rod into the soil to support the plants.
ex.cn: 他往土里插了一根细杆，支撑那些植株。
ex.note: a fishing rod 钓竿；a steel rod 钢杆

ex.en: A sack of compost sat beside the seed boxes.
ex.cn: 麻袋装的堆肥放在种子箱旁边。
ex.note: a sack of 一袋；give sb. the sack 解雇某人

ex.en: Two hundred workers were sacked after the factory closed.
ex.cn: 工厂倒闭后，两百名工人被解雇。
ex.note: be sacked 被解雇；sack a shop 洗劫商店

ex.en: "Very good," the man said at last.
ex.cn: “很好。”那人终于说道。
ex.note: it is said that 据说；say nothing 不说话

ex.en: From the ridge the sea lay to the east of the city.
ex.cn: 从山脊上望出去，大海在城市东边。
ex.note: by sea 乘船；the sea of faces 人山人海

ex.en: She said it was sensible to stay near the university.
ex.cn: 她说，待在大学附近是明智的。
ex.note: be sensible to do 做某事是明智的；a sensible choice 明智的选择

ex.en: The three of them shared the bill equally.
ex.cn: 他们三个人平摊了账单。
ex.note: share sth. with sb. 与某人分享；share in 分享（利润）

ex.en: The company now holds a large share of the market.
ex.cn: 这家公司如今占据了很大一部分市场份额。
ex.note: a share of … …的一部分；market share 市场份额

ex.en: In cold weather the soil shrinks away from the pots.
ex.cn: 天冷的时候，土会从盆边缩回去。
ex.note: shrink from 退缩；shrink to 缩小到

ex.en: "Very good, sir," the interviewer said.
ex.cn: “很好，先生。”面试官说道。
ex.note: Yes, sir 是，先生（正式称呼）

ex.en: The child was shy and slow with numbers.
ex.cn: 那孩子腼腆，算数也慢。
ex.note: slow at sth. 在某方面反应慢；a slow learner 学得慢的人

ex.en: The driver slowed down as the road climbed.
ex.cn: 路开始上坡，司机放慢了速度。
ex.note: slow down 减速；slow up 放慢

ex.en: The evidence was solid enough to support the claim.
ex.cn: 证据足够扎实，可以支撑这个说法。
ex.note: solid evidence 确凿的证据；solid ground 坚实的地面

ex.en: Ice is the solid form of water.
ex.cn: 冰是水的固态。
ex.note: in solid form 呈固态；a solid 固体

ex.en: He took a spade and turned the soil over.
ex.cn: 他拿起铁锹把土翻了一遍。
ex.note: a spade and a shovel 一锹一铲；the ace of spades 黑桃A

ex.en: They split the bill three ways.
ex.cn: 他们把账单分成三份。
ex.note: split sth. between/among 在…之间分摊；split up 分手

ex.en: There was a small split in the wall of the old house.
ex.cn: 老屋的墙上有一道细小的裂缝。
ex.note: a split in … …上的裂缝；a split in the party 党内分裂

ex.en: The witness made a careful statement about what he had seen.
ex.cn: 证人谨慎地陈述了他所看到的情况。
ex.note: make a statement 作出陈述；a bank statement 银行对账单

ex.en: The database had outgrown its storage.
ex.cn: 那个数据库的存储空间已经不够用了。
ex.note: storage space 存储空间；in storage 储存中

ex.en: She has a corner of the art studio to herself.
ex.cn: 美术工作室里有一个角落归她专用。
ex.note: a recording studio 录音室；a film studio 电影制片厂

ex.en: He was asked to explain the result in his summary.
ex.cn: 他被要求解释摘要里的那个结果。
ex.note: a summary of … …的摘要；in summary 总而言之

ex.en: Four years after they met, they had all survived the pressure.
ex.cn: 认识四年之后，他们都挺过了那份压力。
ex.note: survive an accident 从事故中生还；survive sb. 比某人活得长

ex.en: He repeated the old tale about the ghost to everyone.
ex.cn: 他把那个关于鬼的旧传说讲给每个人听。
ex.note: an old tale 古老的传说；a tall tale 夸张的故事

ex.en: An old temple stood at the top of the hill.
ex.cn: 山顶上立着一座古老的寺庙。
ex.note: a Buddhist temple 佛寺；the temple of one's heart 心房

ex.en: The three of them built a fire and enjoyed themselves.
ex.cn: 他们三个人生起一堆火，玩得很开心。
ex.note: by themselves 独自；help themselves to 随便吃

ex.en: He believed in the threat of a deadline more than in ghosts.
ex.cn: 比起鬼魂，他更相信截止日期带来的威胁。
ex.note: a threat to … 对…的威胁；under threat 受到威胁

ex.en: His thesis title was long enough to need two breaths.
ex.cn: 他论文的题目长得要换两次气才说得完。
ex.note: the title of … …的标题；a job title 职位名称

ex.en: The novel was titled "The Salt Road".
ex.cn: 这部小说题为《盐道》。
ex.note: be titled … 题为…；title sb. sth. 授予某人某头衔

ex.en: The company's office stands in a glass tower by the river.
ex.cn: 公司的办公室坐落在河边一座玻璃高塔里。
ex.note: a water tower 水塔；the tower of Babel 巴别塔

ex.en: The old clock tower over the square.
ex.cn: 广场上那座老钟楼高高耸立。
ex.note: tower above/over 高耸于；a tower of strength 力量之塔

ex.en: They followed a path through tall pine trees.
ex.cn: 他们沿着一条小路穿过高高的松树。
ex.note: a pine tree 松树；a family tree 家谱

ex.en: A first-year student needed a tutor in mathematics.
ex.cn: 有个一年级学生需要一位数学辅导老师。
ex.note: a private tutor 家庭教师；be tutor to sb. 是某人的导师

ex.en: He earned a little money tutoring first-year students.
ex.cn: 他靠辅导一年级学生赚一点零花。
ex.note: tutor sb. in … 辅导某人的…

ex.en: Unfortunately, the hotel had lost his reservation.
ex.cn: 不幸的是，酒店把他的预订弄丢了。
ex.note: 句首用 unfortunately 表示转折；接好消息时用 fortunately

ex.en: The idea sounds useless, but it actually works.
ex.cn: 这个主意听上去没用，可它真的管用。
ex.note: be useless for 对…无用；be useless to do 做某事是没用的

ex.en: The evidence was very strong, and everyone was convinced.
ex.cn: 证据非常有力，所有人都信服了。
ex.note: very + adj. 非常；very much 非常；very good 很好

ex.en: That is the very man I was looking for.
ex.cn: 那正是我要找的那个人。
ex.note: the very + n. 正是那个；the very next 紧接着的

ex.en: The colours in the film were so vivid that she looked them up.
ex.cn: 电影里的颜色那么鲜明，她便去查了它们是怎么来的。
ex.note: a vivid description 生动的描述；vivid colours 鲜艳的颜色

ex.en: She wore a waterproof jacket because the weather might turn.
ex.cn: 她穿着防水夹克，因为天气可能说变就变。
ex.note: waterproof shoes 防水鞋；be waterproof to 防（…）水

ex.en: They took a train west in February to climb a mountain.
ex.cn: 二月里他们坐火车往西，去爬一座山。
ex.note: in the west 在西方；west of 在…以西

ex.en: The new method is now widespread in schools across the country.
ex.cn: 这种方法如今在全国各所学校广为采用。
ex.note: widespread use 广泛使用；be widespread 普遍存在

ex.en: Wool and cotton hung from a line like a strange rainbow.
ex.cn: 羊毛和棉布挂在一根绳子上，像一道奇异的彩虹。
ex.note: a ball of wool 一团毛线；wool socks 毛袜

ex.en: They allowed themselves one bottle of beer each and toasted the year.
ex.cn: 他们破例各喝了一瓶啤酒，为这一年干杯。
ex.note: year after year 年复一年；the academic year 学年
